references.text: Narrative parallel showing the people seeking the Lord's counsel before war, but with a tragic contrast in the opponent (foreigners vs. their own brothers).
Theological contrast: God's permission for war against brothers in Judges (judgment on sin) versus prohibition of war against brothers in 1 Kings (protection of God's plan).
Narrative symmetry: The people weep before the Lord until evening both before the battle (20:23) and after the battle (21:2), marking the depth of despair.
